column1: # The ccd file split's slice table (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-ccd-file-split.md, Task 6; D-8048, D-8634).
# One row per library a slice creates: <move-order><TAB><library><TAB><context><TAB><name-regex>.
# A function of ccd/ccd belongs to the FIRST row in file order whose context is its row's in ccd/contexts.tsv and whose
# regex (Python `re.search`) matches its name, so each context's catch-all row (regex `.`) sits after that context's
# specific rows, whatever its move order. K rows, `die`, `_roster_fp_to` and `_ccd_lib_load` belong to no slice: they
# stay in the spine, and `.github/ci/ccd-split.py` refuses a row that names K. C10 has no row (Task 7).
